hero.eyebrow: Photography & Film — Est. Dhaka, working worldwide
hero.subtext: A boutique photo & video studio for brands, weddings, and directors who'd rather show than tell. Every frame reviewed by hand before it leaves the lab.

reels_lead: Full films behind the stills. Tap any block to play — sound on.
albums_lead: Every shoot filed like a roll of film — browse by category or find the exact event.

item1.title: Photography
item1.description: Editorial, product, and portrait work shot on location or in studio. Every set lit by hand, every frame culled by a human eye, not a preset.

item2.title: Videography
item2.description: Brand films, EPKs, and documentary shorts. We write, shoot, and cut — no hand-offs, no notes lost in translation between departments.

item3.title: Post & Color
item3.description: Grading, retouching, and sound design done in-house, so the print matches what we saw through the viewfinder on set.

step1.title: Concept
step1.description: A working call to understand the brief, the audience, and the one shot the whole project hinges on.

step2.title: Prep & Scout
step2.description: Locations, casting, and a shot list tight enough to move fast on the day without losing the plan.

step3.title: Production
step3.description: A small crew, a quiet set, and a director who's watching the monitor, not the clock.

step4.title: Edit & Deliver
step4.description: Selects sent within 48 hours. Final cut, color, and files delivered on a schedule you signed off on.

testimonial.quote: “They showed up, watched the room for twenty minutes before touching a camera, and the footage still looks like us — just clearer.”
